app_fee.value: Every applicant pays a $60 non-refundable application fee.
app_fee.quote: All applicants are required to pay a $60 non-refundable Application Fee

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver for international applicants appears on the graduate pages fetched; the waiver page covers English-test exemptions only.

gre_general.value: GRE or GMAT is required only for some PhD programs; each program record gives its own rule.
gre_general.quote: Applicants to select Ph.D. programs are required to submit GRE/GMAT scores

toefl_min.value: The English policy prints a TOEFL iBT minimum of 4, which is not a usable iBT score on the current 0 to 120 scale, so no TOEFL minimum is recorded here; confirm the figure with Graduate Admissions.
toefl_min.quote: To be considered for admission to Stevens graduate programs, students must score at least 4 on TOEFL iBT, 6 on IELTS, or 110 on DuoLingo

ielts_min.value: The minimum for admission is an IELTS of 6; a score of 7 or higher also exempts the applicant from the English language course.
ielts_min.quote: students must score at least 4 on TOEFL iBT, 6 on IELTS, or 110 on DuoLingo

english_waiver.value: A bachelor's degree from a university abroad that teaches in English can waive the test, but the applicant must upload an official letter from that institution and then sit the Stevens English exam on arrival.
english_waiver.quote: Earned a bachelor's degree from a college/university outside the U.S. that uses English as the language of instruction | must provide an official document from the institution at which they were enrolled that states that English was the language of instruction for their program

notes: Official list of 20 PhD programs: https://www.stevens.edu/phd-at-stevens/phd-programs. Fee and waiver checked on the graduate pages; the $60 fee is the same for all applicants. Not reviewed as fields: Interdisciplinary Engineering, Interdisciplinary Science, Engineering Management, Systems Engineering, Socio-Technical Systems, Business Administration, Financial Engineering (no matching field or not STEM core). Ocean Engineering, Ph.D. is in the civil department and was not fetched.
